profile.ja: 魔のものに対抗するため、化学の粋を集めて強化された存在。タイプヒーローというコードネームで呼ばれていた。特別兵装として、シンイとカムイという装備を持つ。シンイは特殊な粒子により作られたブレード、カムイは常時展開可能なシールドである。兵装の負荷に耐えられるよう遺伝子操作も行われており、常人の数倍の身体能力を誇る。感情表現には乏しく、常に冷静、人に仇なす存在を駆逐するマシーンと化しているが、時折子供っぽい動作や仕草をみせることがあり、それが本来の性格であると伺い知ることができる。現在は水城家の居候として幸せに暮らしている。
profile.en: They are an existence enhanced with the essence of chemistry to counter demonic forces, known by the codename Type Hero. They possess special equipment, Shin'i and Kamui. Shin'i is a blade made from special particles, and Kamui is a shield that can be deployed at any time. They have undergone genetic modification to withstand the load of their equipment, boasting physical abilities several times that of a normal person. They are often calm and lack emotional expression, having become a machine dedicated to eliminating forces that harm people. However, they occasionally display childish actions and behaviors, which may be a glimpse into their true personality. Currently, they live with the Mizuki family, where they are happy.

text.ja: ん……久しぶり。この服？　可愛くて気に入ってる。ご奉仕？　はよく分からないけど
text.en: Hm... it's been a while. This outfit? I think it's cute and I like it. Service? I'm not really sure what that means, but...

text.ja: この服は戦いにくいけど……可愛いって言われるのは、好き
text.en: This outfit is hard to fight in... but being told it's cute is nice.

text.ja: ゆきかぜは夜部屋でずっと何かしてる。早く寝た方が沢山寝られるのに
text.en: Yukikaze is always doing something in her room at night. She should go to sleep earlier so she can get more rest.

text.ja: メイド服もっと見たいの？　いいよ、好きなだけ見て。わたしも……なんか嬉しい
text.en: You want to see more of my maid outfit? It's okay, you can look as much as you want. It makes me... happy.

text.ja: 任務があればふうまに会えるから、頑張る。でも、一緒に遊びにも……行きたい
text.en: If I have a mission, I'll get to see Fuuma, so I'll do my best. But I also want to play with her... and have fun together.

text.ja: ふうまはもうちょっと遊びに来て欲しい。ゆきかぜのいない日？　うん、教える
text.en: I wish Fuuma would come and play more often. On days when Yukikaze is not around? Yeah, I'll tell her.

text.ja: わたしみたいなメイドがいたら嬉しい……？　なら、ふうまのメイドになってもいいよ？
text.en: Would you be happy if you had a maid like me? If so, I'd be happy to be Fuuma's maid.

text.ja: フリフリヒラヒラで可愛いと、ふうまに褒めて貰える……そうなんだ
text.en: If I'm cute in a frilly outfit, Fuuma will praise me... that's what I think.

text.ja: いっぱいエッチなご奉仕も、したい……上手くできたら頭ぽんぽん、して？
text.en: I want to do a lot of erotic service too... if I can do it well, will you reward me with a pat on the head?

text.ja: ふうまのおちんちん、アイスと同じくらい好き、ん、れろっ、ペロペロなめると大っきくなる……♪
text.en: Fuuma's thing is as cute as ice cream, and when I lick it, it gets bigger...♪

text.ja: んぁっ、あぅ、わたしがご奉仕するのに気持ち良くなっちゃってる、んぅ、……ね、もっと……して？
text.en: Ah, ah, I'm feeling good when I'm serving Fuuma... can you do more?
